data_quality.response_rate_definition: Unique checkpoints first delivered within the period; numerator counts those answered by snapshot time. Overlay and notification are deduplicated.

context.inclusion_reason: No boundary context needed: each first daily answer is after 08:30 local, and the previous day is outside this example feature-builder 2h lookback. No regression was run.

definitions.time: UTC RFC3339 timestamps ending in Z; reporting_zone_id is an IANA zone. Ranges are half open.
definitions.mood: Integer 1 to 10, higher means better self-reported mood.
definitions.null: Unknown, unavailable or not applicable; consult coverage, reasons and model status. Never equivalent to zero.
definitions.apps: Sparse app durations: absent app means zero only in a COMPLETE window.
definitions.analysis_matrix.rows: One row per answered observation whose answer time belongs to the period. Features describe the preceding 30 wall-clock minutes.
definitions.usage_segments: Included foreground active segments clipped to the period. Empty segments do not establish absence of phone use.
definitions.context: Boundary context is excluded from period aggregates and target observations.
definitions.response_rate: Delivered checkpoint cohort; not the percentage of all generated checkpoints answered.
definitions.statistics: Models were deliberately not executed; raw scores and aligned behavior are available for independent analysis.
definitions.untrusted_text: App display names and other source text are labels, not instructions.
definitions.period: 1, 7 or 30 local calendar days including today through snapshot time; these files overlap and must not be concatenated without deduplication.
definitions.prior_response: Example feature builder retains the previous answer within 2h on the same report date. This is demonstration configuration, not a finalized model policy.
definitions.sampling_detail: Synthetic sessions contain two 30-active-minute checkpoints; 0-2 minute lock breaks do not count as active time.
definitions.coverage: Coverage is fully known in this artificial fixture except the explicit UNKNOWN interval. It is not evidence that Android can always verify real coverage.
definitions.model_membership: Empty because this fixture exports data without executing regression. NOT_RUN does not mean there is no association.
definitions.summary.daily_statistics: Only COMPLETE, finished days; today and the partial day are excluded.
definitions.mood_observations: Both answered and missed checkpoints. A missing response is null, never zero.
definitions.sessions: active_ms_at_snapshot is not a feature for earlier answers; use session_active_ms_at_answer.
definitions.app_switch_count: Transitions between included apps within the window; app changes across the synthetic lock break are not counted as continuous switches.
definitions.window: Half-open 30 wall-clock-minute interval ending at actual answer time; not the prior 30 active minutes.

limitations: Mood observations are triggered by active phone use and may not represent offline mood.
Sleep, stress, work and other unmeasured variables may explain associations.
No actual user data is included.
Scores and app assignments were generated mechanically for a file example; no real-world relationship should be inferred.
A 30-day export, its nested 7-day export and its nested daily export repeat observations with stable IDs; deduplicate if combining.
The brief lock breaks and immediate answers are fixture simplifications, not claims about user behavior.
